video_title: AJ Dybantsa OUTDUELS Darryn Peterson in No. 1 vs. No. 2 NBA Summer League matchup 😤 | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on AJ Dybantsa's athleticism and finishing ability
quotes.excerpt: The athleticism jumps off the page when you see him just on the highlight plays.
quotes.quote: The athleticism jumps off the page when you see him just on the highlight plays. The fact that he was able to absorb contact, play to it, play through it. Those are things that you want to see especially from an 18, 19-year-old who's only going to get bigger and stronger. But the ability to finish at the rim, finish over contact and through it, not just the poster dunk but the reverse layup to show you that he can play around the rim, he can use the rim as a shield.

quotes.speaker: Wendy Nix
quotes.summary_phrase: Wendy Nix and Vince Carter on AJ Dybantsa's leg injury and future
quotes.excerpt: I've seen first-round draft picks get shut down on cramps before.

text_blocks.speaker: Wendy Nix
text_blocks.text: AJ Dybantsa and that leg injury. Feels like teams are going to be cautious, certainly the Washington Wizards want to protect that investment. Do you think that we see him again in the Summer League or is he going to have an early exit?

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Maybe not. He said it was leg soreness. It could have been a cramp, but I've seen first-round draft picks get shut down on cramps before. But forget about all that. What he showed was incredible power going to the basket. That is what he is known for, his strong mid-range game. He didn't shoot the ball great from the outside, he was 0-5 on three, that is what is in the scouting report, but he drew eight shooting fouls, looked for contact. Excellent debut for him.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on AJ Dybantsa's ball handling and turnover rate
quotes.excerpt: He was out there for 26 minutes. He was handling the ball a lot. He had one turnover.
quotes.quote: He was out there for 26 minutes. He was handling the ball a lot. He had one turnover. And that's one of the things that you see from young players, they turn the ball over a lot. That certainly was what Darryn Peterson was dealing with last night.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter's critique of Darryn Peterson's playmaking and turnovers
quotes.excerpt: He is turning the ball over a ton. He has 18 of them in the first three games.
quotes.quote: He is turning the ball over a ton. He has 18 of them in the first three games here. He had eight last night. I don't know if he's ready to play a lot of point guard at the NBA level here. He's definitely can handle the ball and the ball is going to be funneled to him, but I don't know if they're ready to have him be a primary point guard.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on Jaylen Brown's comments about loyalty in sports
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown already knew that there was no loyalty in sports. He didn't have to be traded for that.
quotes.quote: When LeBron is having his free agency done on a podcast with Max Kellerman and Rich Paul, and you see Ishowspeed and Jaylen Brown, these are today's athletes and the way that they communicate directly to people. Jaylen Brown already knew that there was no loyalty in sports. He didn't have to be traded for that. He was on a Boston Celtics team where Isaiah Thomas put his injured hip on the line and everything else for the team and did not get rewarded with a contract extension after the year. He got rewarded with a trade to Cleveland and a couple years later he was out of the league. It's all performative, it's almost a fun, but everybody knows what they're doing.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on the Timberwolves' pitch to LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I got Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball. I need an adult in the room, man.
quotes.quote: Rich, LeBron, this is Chris Finch. I don't know if you know, but we've made the Western Conference finals two times out of the last three years. You might want to forget about that time we beat y'all in five games in the first round a couple years ago. Forget all that. I got Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball. I need an adult in the room, man. Come over here and help me, because I got a bunch of kids and they don't know how to act. And Alex Rodriguez, you're closer to his age than everybody else is. You can use his plane to go somewhere because we don't really got golf courses here, we got lakes. So you can fly wherever you want to fly and go play golf. But Ant-Man, play with him.

quotes.speaker: Wendy Nix
quotes.summary_phrase: Wendy Nix on why LeBron James should consider the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: I would seriously consider Denver if I was LeBron. But if it's not going to be Jokic, why not Giannis?
quotes.quote: I've been thinking more and more about LeBron in Miami because when he went back to Cleveland it was about making something right. The way it went ended in Miami wasn't quite right and there'd be something about making something right. And look, I would seriously consider Denver if I was LeBron. But if it's not going to be Jokic, why not Giannis?

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on why Erik Spoelstra is a better coach now
quotes.excerpt: Spoelstra has become a better coach since LeBron has left.
quotes.quote: Think of the relationship that we know that he has had with Erik Spoelstra that has evolved through the years. Spoelstra has become a better coach since LeBron has left. Pat Riley still has his fastball because he just snagged Giannis Antetokounmpo.
